knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)

This code uses the {lubridate} function [`with_tz()`](https://lubridate.tidyverse.org/reference/with_tz.html) to convert a specific time to a different time zone.


## What time is it now?


```{r}

# local time
now()

# Tokyo
now(tz = "Asia/Tokyo")

```


```{r}
# assign now() to an object

current_time <- now()
current_time


# convert time
with_tz(current_time, tzone = "Asia/Tokyo")

```


## Tokyo vs New York

In this example, we first set a specific time object `time_to_convert`. This uses the {lubridate} function `ymd_hm()` to create a date-time object that is one minute past midnight in New York.

Next, the code uses the `with_tz()` function to change the time to Tokyo.


```{r}
# one minute past midnight
time_to_convert <- ymd_hm("2026-09-17 00:01", tz = "America/New_York")

time_to_convert

with_tz(time_to_convert, tzone = "Asia/Tokyo")

```
